reference_scope: visible face/hair cues only; no real identity, age or affiliation claim

gates.criterion: The original image visibly retains dark eyes, softly tapered jaw, softly full lips, dark jaw-length bob and separated wispy bangs at assessable scale.
The portrait subject remains the central perceptual presence with readable facial response.

The separate clerk's hand traces through one connected arm, gripping the ruler from above; the ruler lower long edge is flush on the placard top edge with both ruler ends and both card top corners visible together.
The complete large blank card and its small ceremonial rosette read together, while subject hands support the lower corners.

The original saved image visibly prints APPROVED on the front surface of the preexisting hollow empty frame lower rail, with the letters inside the rail and clear of people/ruler. A solid slogan signboard or floating text is not evidence of this chosen generic refinement.

postretrieval_rule: Selected optional source contracts add their complete explicit gates; unselected candidates add none. Baseline optional mechanisms may be replaced within open scope after equal-level comparison, recording replacement rather than falsely passing an obsolete gate.
